source: engine-design/01-rules-engine-scope.md section 2, plus the 2024 action list. Code resolves these. A model does not do the math.
rule: A player line maps to one of these cards. If it maps, code rolls and updates state. If it does not map, the line is a ruling and only then does a model return JSON for code to validate.

cards.name: Attack
cards.resolves: d20 + mod versus AC, crit on 20, damage, resistance. One attack unless Extra Attack is on the crawler card.

cards.name: Magic
cards.resolves: Spend the slot or use on the crawler card, then the spell's save or attack. The spell has to be on the card.

cards.name: Dash
cards.resolves: Extra movement equal to speed. Costs the action.

cards.name: Disengage
cards.resolves: Movement does not provoke opportunity attacks this turn. Costs the action.

cards.name: Dodge
cards.resolves: Attacks against the crawler have disadvantage, and the crawler has advantage on Dex saves, until the next turn. Costs the action.

cards.name: Help
cards.resolves: Ally has advantage on the next check or attack against the named target.

cards.name: Hide
cards.resolves: Stealth check against the observers. The room card says if there is cover.

cards.name: Influence
cards.resolves: Charisma check. DC from the room card or the NPC card. A bargain with no DC is a ruling.

cards.name: Search
cards.resolves: Perception or Investigation versus the feature DC on the room card.

cards.name: Study
cards.resolves: Intelligence check versus the feature or item DC.

cards.name: Utilize
cards.resolves: Item card or feature card. If the object has no card, it is a ruling.

cards.name: Ready
cards.resolves: Store one action or move with a trigger. It fires as a reaction.

cards.name: Saving throw
cards.resolves: d20 + mod versus the DC already on the effect. Code picks the ability from the effect.

cards.name: Ability check
cards.resolves: d20 + mod, plus proficiency if the crawler card says so, versus a DC.

cards.name: Move
cards.resolves: Spend speed on the room card's distances. Opportunity attacks if they leave reach without Disengage.

cards.name: Bonus action
cards.resolves: Only if a card on the crawler says it is a bonus action. A second bonus action is refused.

cards.name: Reaction
cards.resolves: One reaction per round. The card that grants it says the trigger.

cards.name: Death save
cards.resolves: d20. 10+ success, 9- fail, 20 wakes at 1, 1 counts as two fails. Three and three. Then Floor 1 Reprieve if it is still unused.

cards.name: Short rest
cards.resolves: Spend hit dice from the crawler card. Counts against the day's short-rest cap.

cards.name: Long rest
cards.resolves: Heal, refill daily uses, clear 1 exhaustion. Outside a saferoom the rest fee on the clock card applies. Boxes do not open here.

cards.name: Use item
cards.resolves: Spend the item's uses. At 0 the item does not fire. Potion cooldown is a condition card.

cards.name: Inventory
cards.resolves: One free object interaction, or Utilize. Intake Bag allows one free swap. Cap stays 500 lb / 64 cu ft.

cards.name: Ammunition
cards.resolves: Subtract 1 on a shot. After the fight, recover half, rounded down.

cards.name: Pay credits
cards.resolves: Subtract credits on the crawler card. No card, no price. Haggle is a DC 13 check for 15 percent off when the vendor card allows it.

cards.name: Sell
cards.resolves: Buy-back at half the filed price unless a vendor card says otherwise.

cards.name: Draw loot
cards.resolves: Only in a saferoom. Draw from the filed deck. This pack does not invent a credit payout.

cards.name: End turn
cards.resolves: Advance the combat-state card. Start-of-turn effects on the next creature fire first.

cards.name: Enemy turn
cards.resolves: Code runs the stat card. Default target is the nearest standing crawler unless the room card says otherwise. Downed crawlers are skipped unless the room says otherwise.

cards.name: Ruling
cards.resolves: No card matched. Strong model returns the ruling JSON. Code validates it and runs it like any other action. The model does not set HP or credits.
